colors.primary: Sage-forest, the one accent: filled CTAs, the send button, the unread pill, links, the wordmark. Text on it is `on-primary`; as text it clears 4.5:1 on every surface tier.
colors.on-primary: Mandatory text on a `primary` fill (7.4:1 light). Never `on-surface` on `primary`: dark-on-dark is a bug.
colors.primary-container: A tint, never a dense fill: the athlete's bubble, the active rail item, a selected tile, an avatar ground, the login aside in light.
colors.primary-hover: Hover fill of a filled `primary`; `on-primary` keeps its contrast (white 9.2:1).
colors.primary-fixed: MD3 fixed tone; the mint of the dark accent family.
colors.primary-fixed-dim: MD3 fixed-dim tone; chart ramps and the dark primary.
colors.secondary: MD3 neutral secondary; rarely used in product — prefer `on-surface-variant`.
colors.tertiary: Deep boreal ink (light) / pale sage (dark); the sixth avatar slot.
colors.error: Failed, destructive, blocking. A dot, a rule or an error underline; `.btn-danger` fill with `on-error`.
colors.error-container: Dense error container — never on a dark card beside the page's one action; prefer an `error` tint.
colors.surface: Warm paper, the one ground: rail, list column, thread canvas, every page. Panes are separated by hairlines, not fill steps.
colors.surface-container-lowest: Cards, the composer field, popovers, table bodies (white in light). In dark it sits BELOW the canvas — lift a dark card to `surface-container-high`.
colors.surface-container-low: Composer and search fields, row hover, the day pill; the login aside in dark.
colors.surface-container-high: The dark resting card; the neutral `.badge` ground.
colors.surface-container-highest: Top tier; reserved. `outline` text still clears 4.5:1 here (4.51:1 light, the binding pair).
colors.on-surface: Body ink on every surface tier (17.3:1 top, 10.9:1 bottom in light). Never pure black.
colors.on-surface-variant: Muted body copy, descriptions, inactive tabs (≥5.95:1 on every light tier).
colors.outline: A TEXT role: helper lines, timestamps, counts, section labels; the edge of a checkbox or radio. Clears 4.5:1 on every tier in its scheme.
colors.outline-variant: Inactive icons, separator hints, the offline status dot. Not for text.
colors.scrim: The veil behind a sheet, drawer or dialog, drawn at 60%.
colors.activity: Activity pillar — movement, fitness, training load. Drawn as an 8px dot beside a word, an avatar ground or a tint; text on it takes `on-activity-container`.
colors.nutrition: Nutrition pillar — food, fuel, calories. Bare on `surface` it is 3.2:1: never body text. Drawn as an 8px dot beside a word, an avatar ground or a tint; text on it takes `on-nutrition-container`.
colors.recovery: Recovery pillar — sleep, HRV, rest. Drawn as an 8px dot beside a word, an avatar ground or a tint; text on it takes `on-recovery-container`.
colors.mobility: Mobility pillar — flexibility, range of motion. Drawn as an 8px dot beside a word, an avatar ground or a tint; text on it takes `on-mobility-container`.
colors.success: Connected, completed, healthy. A dot, rule or /15 tint; its label takes `on-success-container`. Never a stock Tailwind shade.
colors.warning: Pending, attention, advisory. A dot, rule or /15 tint; its label takes `on-warning-container`. Never a stock Tailwind shade.
colors.info: Informational, processing. A dot, rule or /15 tint; its label takes `on-info-container`. Never a stock Tailwind shade.
colors.on-activity-container: Bound ink: text on a /10–/15 tint of `activity` over any tier (≥4.58:1 light, ≥4.73:1 dark); /20 up to `surface-container-high`.
colors.on-nutrition-container: Bound ink: text on a /10–/15 tint of `nutrition` over any tier (≥4.58:1 light, ≥4.73:1 dark); /20 up to `surface-container-high`.
colors.on-recovery-container: Bound ink: text on a /10–/15 tint of `recovery` over any tier (≥4.58:1 light, ≥4.73:1 dark); /20 up to `surface-container-high`.
colors.on-mobility-container: Bound ink: text on a /10–/15 tint of `mobility` over any tier (≥4.58:1 light, ≥4.73:1 dark); /20 up to `surface-container-high`.
colors.on-info-container: Bound ink: text on a /10–/15 tint of `info` over any tier (≥4.58:1 light, ≥4.73:1 dark); /20 up to `surface-container-high`.
colors.on-success-container: Bound ink: text on a /10–/15 tint of `success` over any tier (≥4.58:1 light, ≥4.73:1 dark); /20 up to `surface-container-high`.
colors.on-warning-container: Bound ink: text on a /10–/15 tint of `warning` over any tier (≥4.58:1 light, ≥4.73:1 dark); /20 up to `surface-container-high`.
colors.ghost-border: The 1px hairline at pane edges, cards, fields and the composer. The ink changes between schemes, not only the opacity.
colors.ghost-border-strong: A separator that must read; active separators. Not a control edge (1.55:1) — use `outline` for that.
colors.ghost-border-faint: The divider INSIDE a list or table, inset to the text.
colors.mark-ink: The Boreal Ripple mark's ink: forest on every light surface, mint on the dark canvas. Never a pillar hue.
colors.forest-50: Forest tonal ramp (`PRIMARY_PALETTE`) for chart gradients and data-density ramps only — not UI chrome.
colors.forest-100: Forest tonal ramp (`PRIMARY_PALETTE`) for chart gradients and data-density ramps only — not UI chrome.
colors.forest-200: Forest tonal ramp (`PRIMARY_PALETTE`) for chart gradients and data-density ramps only — not UI chrome.

colors.forest-400: Forest tonal ramp (`PRIMARY_PALETTE`) for chart gradients and data-density ramps only — not UI chrome.
colors.forest-500: Forest tonal ramp (`PRIMARY_PALETTE`) for chart gradients and data-density ramps only — not UI chrome.
colors.forest-600: Forest tonal ramp (`PRIMARY_PALETTE`) for chart gradients and data-density ramps only — not UI chrome.
colors.forest-700: Forest tonal ramp (`PRIMARY_PALETTE`) for chart gradients and data-density ramps only — not UI chrome.
colors.forest-800: Forest tonal ramp (`PRIMARY_PALETTE`) for chart gradients and data-density ramps only — not UI chrome.
colors.forest-900: Forest tonal ramp (`PRIMARY_PALETTE`) for chart gradients and data-density ramps only — not UI chrome.
colors.forest-950: Forest tonal ramp (`PRIMARY_PALETTE`) for chart gradients and data-density ramps only — not UI chrome.
colors.provider-strava: Strava orange (third-party). Glyph clears 3:1 on both canvases. Only inside that provider's glyph or connection tile, marked as a third-party colour.
colors.provider-garmin: Garmin blue (third-party). Only inside that provider's glyph or connection tile, marked as a third-party colour.
colors.provider-whoop: WHOOP green (third-party). 1.83:1 on light paper: the glyph takes `on-surface` in light. Only inside that provider's glyph or connection tile, marked as a third-party colour.
colors.provider-intervals-icu: intervals.icu blue (third-party). Only inside that provider's glyph or connection tile, marked as a third-party colour.
colors.provider-trainingpeaks: TrainingPeaks blue (third-party). 2.46:1 on the dark canvas: the glyph takes `on-surface` in dark. Only inside that provider's glyph or connection tile, marked as a third-party colour.
colors.provider-coros: COROS red (third-party). Only inside that provider's glyph or connection tile, marked as a third-party colour.

spacing.space-md: Standard component padding; card padding on a phone.
spacing.space-lg: Card padding at md+, section gap.
spacing.space-xl: Major section separation; the gap between Sections.

radius.radius-md: Chips on the phone, small insets.
radius.radius-xl: Cards, the composer field, floating panels.
radius.radius-bubble: The athlete's bubble (with a 4px tail corner, bottom-right).
radius.radius-full: Badges, tags, avatars, status dots only.

shadow.shadow-floating: Menus, popovers, drawers, modals — never a resting card.

layout.note: Fixed dimensions of the messenger shell and controls (DESIGN.md §5–6).

styles.name: mono-stat

styles.name: m-text-base
